<thought>We need three retrosynthetic steps:
1. Break the amide C–N bond → aromatic α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid + aniline (amide coupling, forward breaks a C–O bond of a carboxylic acid and forms a C–N amide bond).
2. Break the C=C bond of the α,β‑unsaturated acid → aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid (Doebner modification, forward forms a C=C bond and loses CO₂).
3. Break the sulfonamide N–S bond → sulfonyl chloride attached to the second phenyl + p‑toluidine (sulfonamide formation, forward forms an N–S bond).

We will locate suitable templates for each forward reaction using the catalog search, then build the retrosynthetic tree.
